follow-up time: Until delivery, within 24 hours of induction
exposure: Indication for induction (post-term pregnancy, fetal reasons, maternal reasons)
Vaginal misoprostol 200 mug for labor induction
outcome: Time from misoprostol insertion to vaginal delivery
cohort: 197 pregnant women undergoing labor induction with vaginal misoprostol
finding: Vaginal misoprostol 200 mug was found to be an effective and safe method for labor induction, with a 50.8% vaginal birth rate within 24 hours, and parity being a significant predictor of success.
